Definition: or Ναζαρέτ; of uncertain derivation; Nazareth or Nazaret, a place in Palestine:--Nazareth.
BiblicalUsage: Gabriel is sent to Nazareth to a virgin, and Peter preaches Jesus of Nazareth, whom God anointed with the Holy Ghost and with power. The crowds at Jerusalem say this is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Nazareth is where the gospel begins on earth: a town with no standing, a girl with no fame, and a child who would be called the prophet from Galilee. God starts His greatest work in the smallest place.
